title: Pharmaceutical Procurement Intelligence Agent
short: Prepares purchase plans, compares quotations and tenders, and flags price and supply risks for the procurement team.
symptom: Quotations and tenders are compared by hand
ingredient: A procurement analyst that never gets tired
directions: Upload needs, quotations and contract terms. Get a side-by-side comparison, a recommended purchase plan and the risks of each option.
problem: Procurement teams compare quotations with different pack sizes, currencies, lead times, shelf lives and payment terms, while tracking contracts and tender deadlines manually.
why: Poor comparisons lead to overpaying, short-dated stock or unreliable suppliers.
solution: Normalizes quotations to cost per unit and per treatment, checks remaining shelf life and lead time against need dates, links supplier risk scores, and drafts a purchase plan and tender summary for approval.
technology: AI agent workflow with approval step
limitations: Tender rules and procurement law must be followed exactly
review: Procurement officers and, where required, tender committees make every award decision.
